about: The collecta of the formulary “4th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, that the course of the world may be directed according to Your rule in peace and that Your Church may have the joy of serving You undisturbed. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: making or tending to make peace
